category: Lipi — the script and its orthography
label: punctuation: the daṇḍa, and almost nothing else
note: Closed by SA-C60-danda, one short lesson, exactly as the earlier note predicted. It teaches the single stroke, the doubled stroke that ends a verse, and what classical Sanskrit uses INSTEAD of the marks English has -- `iti` for a quotation, `kim` for a question.
